answer: That closes the loop where an operator edits the ledger and answers against its own edit in the same window, which costs it the epoch. Because the ridge height is fixed at intake and recorded in the reef receipt, the atlas audit and the replay can prove which state the answer was judged against. Answers are graded against a checkpoint at least 829 seconds old, so a submission cannot be scored against state it just changed itself. That is 25 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
